content: The dissertation says Suʾl al-Mulūk was written in 829/1426 for Bāysunghur, that it ends with a lettrist prognostication reckoned from Shāhrukh's name that Timurid glory would last a century, and that Bāysunghur (d. 837/1433) was the Timurid elite member most interested in his lettrism despite royal antipathy to hurufism.
refers_to_primary: R. Suʾl al-Mulūk, MS Majlis 10196 f. 178b
